The key is to understand how interest rates effect the value of an asset and how houses are priced.
If you are unfamiliar with NPV this isn't a bad thing to look at http://www.investopedia.com/terms/n/npv.asp That stands for Net Present Value.

What it amounts to if you do a lot of math (integral) is that the value of an asset is proportional to the monthly amount people are willing to pay for something and inversely proportional to the interest rate (real interest rate).

If you take a house people are willing to pay $4000 a month for with a 5% interest rate people are willing to pay price X. If you drop the interest rate to 2.5% people are willing to pay 2X.

What this means is that supply and demand aren't coordinated. Let's just go over notifications on Voat in their entirety. There are five ways to be pinged, and I'll break them into 3 sections:

  1. Receive a PM (a message in your inbox).

  2. Receive a reply to your submission or your comment.

  3. Get an "@" or "/u/" mention in a comment or submission.

  • The third way, through mentions, can only happen at the time the post is made. Editing a mention into a post or comment will not cause the user to be notified.

  • Mentions and replies are separate ways to trigger notifications. For example, when I type @X-Y here, you will now receive two notifications.

(To understand the last bullet point fully, this was received originally as a reply to a comment from @X-Y)

The point I think few may know is "Editing a mention into a post or comment will not cause the user to be notified."

Credit goes to @heygeorge for providing this info.
